## Highlights
- Added paging to `/stac/collections` so large registries no longer return every collection in one oversized response.
- Added an admin repair endpoint that renames organizations and datasets with invalid slugs (such as `a--b`) to make them reachable again.
- Improved STAC landing page speed by no longer opening every dataset index to read its name.

## Added / Changed
- Added `limit` and `offset` query parameters to `/stac/collections` (default 10, max 100), with `next` and `prev` links plus `numberMatched` and `numberReturned` in the response.
- Added `POST /system/fix-invalid-slugs`, which renames organizations and datasets with invalid slugs and moves organization folders accordingly. It is a dry run by default (pass `dryRun=false` to apply) and skips entries with active jobs.
- Improved the STAC landing page by caching dataset names for 1 hour and reading dataset visibility without opening native indexes.
- Changed dataset ordering in STAC listings to be stable (by id), so offsets and search tokens stay consistent across requests.
- Changed imports to refuse invalid destination slugs up front.

## Fixed
- Fixed organizations and datasets with slugs created before dash collapsing (for example `jane--eric`) being unreachable because they failed slug validation.
- Fixed one unreadable dataset index taking down the whole STAC collections listing. The dataset is now skipped and a warning is logged.

## Breaking changes
- `/stac/collections` now returns one page (10 collections by default) instead of every accessible collection.
  - Migration: follow the `next` link in the response `links` until it is absent.
  - Migration: or pass `limit` (max 100) and `offset` explicitly.
  - Migration: use `numberMatched` to get the total count.
  - Migration: requests with `limit` below 1 now return `400`.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/DroneDB/Registry/compare/v2.7.0...v2.7.1

## Highlights
- Added recoverable indexed job publication to prevent losing submitted work if indexing metadata or state transitions fail during commit.
- Improved stability of background processing by splitting pending build operations into indexed, per-entry tasks to prevent silent failure of retry chains.
- [DroneDB] Updated to version 1.12.2 adding support for Threaded KTX2 model encoding and bundling Obj2Tiles v1.8.0.

## Added / Changed
- Added recoverable indexed job state to protect submitted tasks in cases of database write failures or crashes during publication of metadata.
- Monitor task state as active when jobs are in the `Indexing` state to prevent job tracking from stopping during data preparation.
- Split pending builds queue into indexed, independent building jobs per entry so that single-entry build errors are visible instead of being reported as complete.
- [Hub] Ordered upload requests to process companion files before uploading the main 3D model.
- [Hub] Updated task monitor on Hub to treat `Indexing` as an active state during dataset processing.
- [Hub] Adjusted error viewing targets for models built using Obj2Tiles v1.8.0.
- [DroneDB] Updated backend dependency to DroneDB v1.12.2.

## Fixed
- Fixed pending builds retry coordination to store lock budgets in shared database storage to prevent retry chains from stopping when a dataset's cache is invalidated.
- Updated job execution to run only after the database index row commit completes to prevent background tasks from reaching a finished state with no corresponding index data.
- Fixed background processing status checks to read from live storage states directly instead of relying on cached or stale history logs.
- Adjusted build status reporting to display neutral progress messages when completing pending build sweeps.
- [CI] Install .NET 10 environment on Continuous Integration test agents.
- [CI] Release and clear SQLite connection pools during test teardown to clean test data folders successfully on Windows.

## Merged PRs
- Fix pending build retry coordination and processing by @HeDo88TH in https://github.com/DroneDB/Registry/pull/357

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/DroneDB/Registry/compare/v2.6.8...v2.7.0

## Highlights
- Updated the bundled DroneDB dependency to v1.11.7, resolving a critical packaging bug affecting E57 point cloud indexing.
- [DroneDB] Fixed a race condition that could allow two build processes to run simultaneously on the same output.
- [DroneDB] Fixed tile and geoprojection downloads not cleaning up properly after failures.

## Added / Changed
- Bumped DdbVersion to 1.11.7.
- [DroneDB] Added a Docker-based E57 smoke test in CI to catch plugin loading regressions before release.
- [DroneDB] Added stricter CI packaging checks that fail the build if PDAL plugins are missing or misplaced.
- [DroneDB] Improved tile downloads to use a unique temporary file per download, preventing cache clobbering by concurrent processes.
- [DroneDB] Improved geoprojection output to use a random temp filename, avoiding collisions between concurrent processes.

## Fixed
- [DroneDB] Fixed Debian packages missing unversioned PDAL plugin libraries (e.g. `libpdal_plugin_reader_e57.so`), which caused E57 indexing to silently fail on PDAL >= 19.
- [DroneDB] Fixed a stale-inode race in `BuildLock` that could let two processes build simultaneously.
- [DroneDB] Fixed `ThreadLock` to use per-key mutex objects with reference counting, preventing data races and use-after-erase.
- [DroneDB] Fixed tile downloads that failed mid-transfer from being cached as valid, using an atomic temp-file-then-rename pattern.
- [DroneDB] Fixed a misleading "NULL pointer" GDAL error that masked the real cause of geoprojection warp failures.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/DroneDB/Registry/compare/v2.6.7...v2.6.8

## Highlights
- Missing derived products now return a clean 404 instead of a 500 across thumbnail, tile, raster-info, and raster-analysis endpoints.
- [Security] Scrubbed dataset storage paths from background job logs exposed on public datasets.
- [DroneDB] Updated to v1.11.6, fixing transparent deep-zoom tiles.

## Added / Changed
- Improved build-failure diagnostics: failed build jobs now record an ErrorType and a log tail shown in Task History and the tasks API.
- Improved path handling across data endpoints.
- [API] Documented the repeatable "path" query parameter on the download endpoint as an exploded string array, keeping the legacy comma-separated form for shared links.
- [Hub] Added bounded retries for thumbnail requests.
- [Hub] Added an error fallback for map popups.
- [Hub] Gated map-vector rendering on MVT availability.
- [DroneDB] Updated to v1.11.6.
- [DroneDB] Updated vendored spz and spark, reducing WebAssembly heap memory for splat decoding and fixing texture upload.

## Fixed
- Fixed missing derived artifacts (cog/copc/ept and image/tile/raster-info) returning 500; they now return 404 before any native call.
- [Security] Fixed dataset storage paths leaking into job log output visible to anonymous users on public datasets. Paths are now replaced with [dataset].
- [DroneDB] Fixed an integer overflow in tile bounds that made deep-zoom tiles (z23+) render fully transparent.

## Breaking changes
- [DroneDB] build-lod is now a mandatory dependency for Gaussian Splat (RAD) builds, which fail instead of producing LOD-free artifacts.
- Migration: build build-lod via scripts/build-buildlod.{sh,ps1} (or the updated full-build scripts), or place a compatible binary on PATH / set DDB_BUILDLOD_PATH; set DDB_REQUIRE_BUILDLOD=1 in CI to fail early when the toolchain is missing.

## Merged PRs
- Various improvements and fixes by @HeDo88TH in https://github.com/DroneDB/Registry/pull/356

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/DroneDB/Registry/compare/v2.6.6...v2.6.7

## Highlights
- [Hub] Fixed 3D models lying on their side or flipping upside-down when rotating in the unified viewer.
- [DroneDB] Fixed crashes and corrupt artifacts when building `.glb`/`.gltf` files carrying point or line geometry, such as Gaussian splat tiles.
- [Hub] Reworked unified viewer navigation into a single control set with a stable rotation pivot, for a consistent Potree-like feel on flat and globe scenes.

## Added / Changed
- [Hub] Replaced unified viewer navigation controls with a single shared implementation for flat and globe scenes: stable pivot, corrected mouse button mapping, snappier damping and cross-browser wheel normalization.
- [Hub] Added a loading spinner while creating a new dataset.
- [Hub] Clarified the organizations list for users who own no organizations: an empty state now points to Show all and to creating an organization instead of silently redirecting to Upload.
- [DroneDB] Updated to v1.11.5.
- [DroneDB] `.gltf`/`.glb` files are now classified from the primitives they declare instead of the file extension; point-only files become `Generic` (indexed, never built).
- [DroneDB] Hardened GLB and SPZ parsing against corrupt files: GLB chunk lengths are cross-checked against the real file size and implausible `.spz` header point counts are rejected.
- [DroneDB] Skipped a duplicate Assimp parse when indexing `Generic` 3D entries, speeding up indexing of non-mesh 3D files.
- Improved Hangfire jobs retention: completed background jobs now expire according to the configured `HangfireJobRetentionDays` instead of following the default job retention policy.

## Fixed
- [Hub] Fixed model content lying on its side in the unified viewer, notably DroneDB-built tilesets tipped onto their side by an incorrect up-axis correction.
- [Hub] Fixed models flipping upside-down and rotation freezing when dragging past the pole in the unified viewer; rotation is now an absolute turntable clamped before the poles.
- [DroneDB] Fixed `.glb`/`.gltf` files carrying point or line geometry (e.g. Gaussian splat tiles) being built as meshes, which crashed the renderer or produced corrupt PLY output; they are now classified `Generic` (#467).
- [DroneDB] Fixed builds of mixed-content `.glb`/`.gltf` crashing on point and line primitives; those primitives are now dropped at import, building triangle-only meshes.

## Breaking changes
- [DroneDB] The new `.gltf`/`.glb` classification is persisted at index time, so entries indexed before this update keep their stored type (point-only splat files remain `Model`) and behave as before until rescanned.
  - Migration: after deploying, rescan existing datasets containing `.glb`/`.gltf` files (dataset view -> Rescan, or `ddb rescan -w <ddb> --type model` on the dataset folder). Verify with `ddb info <file>`: point-only files should now report type `Generic`.
